cards.questionText:
Gunton City Council to Consider Blandfolk Superstore Proposal

At a Gunton City Council meeting on May 2, members listened to a presentation from representatives of Blandfolk Superstore about building a branch locally. The retail giant proposed erecting an outlet measuring 9,500 square meters just within city limits on Medford Avenue. However, the chosen land has not yet been authorized for commercial establishments, so Blandfolk has requested that the property be rezoned. Gunton mayor Claire O'Rourke told representatives that the council would discuss the proposition this month and address it at their next meeting in June. A spokesperson for Blandfolk said the corporation hopes the proposal will pass, emphasizing that the development would provide employment for up to 190 local residents.

______________________________________________

Gunton Herald
www.guntonherald.com 

       Home | News | Sports | Business | Entertainment | Lifestyle | Opinion | Contact Us
Readers' Comments
Ronald Pinero posted on May 7:
I am writing in regard to an article printed in your newspaper's May 3 edition about the construction proposal from Blandfolk Superstore. As a long-time business owner in Gunton, I am concerned. I manage Ballas Boutique, a clothing store in the downtown area, and many of my friends and business acquaintances also operate private shops in the city. Large corporate retailers have forced many smaller stores out of business in other locations where they have opened, even when such establishments have been situated on the outskirts of towns. I'm not sure most businesses like mine will be able to compete without significantly dropping prices and, by extension, the quality of our goods. For now, Gunton is a very vibrant and diverse city, and I hope the mayor and council members will reject the proposal in order to keep it that way

 ______________________________________________

TO: Ronald Pinero
SUBJECT: Request from Gunton COC
DATE: May 8
Dear Mr. Pinero,
I came across your comments on the Gunton Herald Web site. Your concern is something the board of the Gunton Chamber of Commerce has been discussing, and we agree that something must be done to protect stores in the downtown area, like yours. On June 3, the city council will be holding a public meeting that some of us will be attending. It would be helpful if you joined us at the event. You could give a short talk describing the concerns you mentioned in your comments. You are welcome to use visual aids, bring supporting documents, and invite others who share our concerns. Please let me know if you would like to participate.
Sincerely yours,
Adeline Morris
Secretary, Gunton Chamber of Commerce

childQuestions.questionText: What is the article mainly about?
options: (A) A mayor's recent proposal
(B) A corporation's plans to build a store
(C) A city's thriving downtown scene
(D) A council's efforts to reduce unemployment
correctOptions: (B) A corporation's plans to build a store
childQuestions.transcript: Information: At a Gunton City Council meeting on May 2, members listened to a presentation from representatives of Blandfolk Superstore about building a branch locally. The retail giant proposed erecting an outlet measuring 9,500 square meters just within city limits on Medford Avenue
childQuestions.explanationVi: Bài báo đề cập đến đề xuất từ Blandfolk Superstore để xây dựng một chi nhánh mới trong giới hạn thành phố Gunton (proposed erecting an outlet). Bài viết bao gồm các chi tiết về kích thước đề xuất, vị trí, nhu cầu tái phân khu, và cơ hội việc làm tiềm năng.

childQuestions.questionText: What does Mr. Pinero want Ms. O'Rourke to do?
options: (A) Turn down a proposition from Blandfolk Superstore
(B) Meet with executives from Ballas Boutique
(C) Rezone some property to allow for construction
(D) Defer funding for private business owners
correctOptions: (A) Turn down a proposition from Blandfolk Superstore
childQuestions.transcript: Information: For now, Gunton is a very vibrant and diverse city, and I hope the mayor and council members will reject the proposal in order to keep it that way.
childQuestions.explanationVi: Ông Pinero, một chủ doanh nghiệp địa phương, bày tỏ lo ngại về tác động tiêu cực mà một siêu thị lớn có thể gây ra cho các doanh nghiệp nhỏ như của ông. Ông hy vọng thị trưởng và hội đồng thành phố sẽ từ chối đề xuất này để duy trì sự sôi động và đa dạng của Gunton. (I hope the mayor and council members will reject the proposal in order to keep it that way.)

childQuestions.questionText: In the article, the word "limits" in paragraph 1, is closest in meaning to
options: (A) regulations
(B) borders
(C) levels
(D) obstacles
childQuestions.transcript:
limit (n): a point or level beyond which something does not or may not extend or pass

border (n): a line separating two political or geographical areas
childQuestions.explanationVi: Từ "limits" chỉ ranh giới hoặc giới hạn của thành phố, chỉ ra vị trí mà siêu thị đề xuất sẽ được xây dựng.

childQuestions.questionText: What will take place on June 3?
options: (A) Those on the Gunton City Council will vote on a plan.
(B) Some Chamber of Commerce members will attend a public hearing.
(C) Construction of a large retail outlet will get underway.
(D) Ms. Morris will voice some citizens' concerns at a trial.
correctOptions: (B) Some Chamber of Commerce members will attend a public hearing.
childQuestions.transcript: Information in the mail: On June 3, the city council will be holding a public meeting that some of us will be attending
childQuestions.explanationVi: Theo email, vào ngày 3 tháng 6, hội đồng thành phố sẽ tổ chức một cuộc họp công khai. Adeline Morris từ Phòng Thương mại Gunton mời ông Pinero tham gia và trình bày mối quan ngại của mình.

childQuestions.questionText: What is indicated about Ms. Morris?
options: (A) She is in charge of relocation for the city council.
(B) She runs a store that sells items at bargain prices.
(C) She thinks that Ballas Boutique should be preserved.
(D) She signed a petition sponsored by Gunton City Council
correctOptions: (C) She thinks that Ballas Boutique should be preserved.
childQuestions.transcript:
Information in the Readers' Comments: I (Mr.Pinero) manage Ballas Boutique, a clothing store in the downtown area ... 

Information in the email: Your concern is something the board of the Gunton Chamber of Commerce has been discussing, and we agree that something must be done to protect stores in the downtown area, like yours.

=> Ms. Morris thinks that Ballas Boutique should be preserved.
childQuestions.explanationVi: Trong email, bà Morris thừa nhận mối quan ngại mà ông Pinero đã nêu về việc bảo vệ các cửa hàng ở khu vực trung tâm thành phố, như cửa hàng của ông, khỏi sự cạnh tranh từ các nhà bán lẻ lớn. Điều này cho thấy bà ủng hộ việc bảo vệ các doanh nghiệp địa phương.

To: Alexander Svensson [alex.svensson@oresund.nl]
From: Christine Kaufmann [ckaufmann@kaiserinvestment.de]
Subject: changes to publications
Date: October 7
Dear Mr. Svensson,
We received your invoice yesterday along with the proofs. Thank you for your excellent work. I showed the final drafts to our managing director and, overall, he was pleased. However, he has requested that we change the photograph used on the front cover. He thinks it failed to convey the mood we were going for. We have commissioned a photographer to take a new picture, and I will send it to you by Friday. Unfortunately, we cannot move our original due date as the brochures have to be shipped in time for a campaign launch event we have planned for November.
If our request presents a problem, please let me know right away. You can reach me by phone at 555-2309, extension #42. Otherwise, I will wait to receive your revised invoice. Thank you!
Christine Kaufmann
Publications Manager
Kaiser Investment Service

______________________________________________

Kaiser Investment Services Company Newsletter
Year-end Message from our CEO

As we come to the end of another year, I want to take this opportunity to thank everyone for their commitment and hard work. Once again, Kaiser Investment Services has outperformed analysts' expectations and generated substantial profits for its clients and shareholders. Not only that, but we also continue to top customer satisfaction surveys on financial services companies in Germany. As we reflect on these successes, let us continue to look forward with optimism. In this December issue of the newsletter, learn more about our ongoing expansion into North America and see photos from last month's launch of our marketing campaign in the United States, which was well attended by several potential clients. Other than that, I will see you all at our annual holiday party!
Sincerely,
Matthias Furst[/ckaufimann@kaiserinvestment.de]

childQuestions.questionText: What is true about Oresund Graphics and Design?
options: (A) It accepts checks in the mail as payment.
(B) It did not take pictures for a booklet.
(C) It has its own finance department.
(D) It is based on the fourth floor of a building.
correctOptions: (B) It did not take pictures for a booklet.
childQuestions.transcript:
(A) incorrect: All payments must be made by direct bank transfer or electronically through www.friendpay.com
(C): No given information
(D) incorrect: Based on the address in the Invoice, Kaiser Investment Services is on Floor 4, NOT Oresund Graphics and Design
(B) Correct: Based on services in the Invoice
childQuestions.explanationVi: Trong hóa đơn, Oresund Graphics and Design đã thực hiện thiết kế, bố trí và chụp ảnh cho Báo cáo cổ đông hàng năm, nhưng không có dịch vụ chụp ảnh cho cuốn sách nhỏ "Terms and Conditions".

childQuestions.questionText: What is suggested about Kaiser Investment Services?
options: (A) It is planning to hire a full-time photographer.
(B) It did not receive all of the promised documents.
(C) It may be charged for paying an invoice late.
(D) It will have to pay a fee of €100 for a revision.
correctOptions: (D) It will have to pay a fee of €100 for a revision.
childQuestions.transcript:
Information in the invoice: Requests for additional changes will incur a €100 surcharge per document.
Information in the email: However, he has requested that we change the photograph used on the front cover.
=> Kaiser Investment Services will have to pay a fee of €100 for a revision.
childQuestions.explanationVi: Trong hóa đơn, có ghi rằng các yêu cầu sửa đổi sẽ bị tính phí €100 mỗi tài liệu. Trong email, bà Kaufmann đã yêu cầu thay đổi bức ảnh trên bìa trước, vì vậy Kaiser Investment Services sẽ phải trả phí này.

childQuestions.questionText: What is one purpose of the message?
options: (A) To recognize a firm's top employees
(B) To go over a company's achievements
(C) To announce the results of a sale
(D) To invite participants to a celebration
correctOptions: (B) To go over a company's achievements
childQuestions.transcript: Information: Kaiser Investment Services has outperformed analysts' expectations and generated substantial profits for its clients and shareholders. Not only that, but we also continue to top customer satisfaction surveys on financial services companies in Germany.
childQuestions.explanationVi: Trong thông điệp, CEO của Kaiser Investment Services đã nhắc lại những thành công của công ty trong năm qua, bao gồm việc vượt qua kỳ vọng của các nhà phân tích và duy trì sự hài lòng của khách hàng.

childQuestions.questionText: In the message, the word "outperformed" in paragraph 1, is closest in meaning to
options: (A) taken part in
(B) put apart from
(C) done better than
(D) given more than
childQuestions.transcript:
outperformed (v): to do well in a particular job or activity compared to others of a similar type
=> closest meaning to "done better than"
childQuestions.explanationVi: Từ "outperformed" có nghĩa là làm tốt hơn trong một công việc hoặc hoạt động so với những người khác trong cùng lĩnh vực. Điều này gần nghĩa nhất với "done better than".

childQuestions.questionText: What most likely did Kaiser Investment Services do recently?
options: (A) It held a retirement party for staff members.
(B) It conducted a survey among employees.
(C) It launched a series of new products in Germany.
(D) It distributed brochures to potential US clients.
correctOptions: (D) It distributed brochures to potential US clients.
childQuestions.transcript:
Information in the email: the brochures have to be shipped in time for a campaign launch event we have planned for November

Information in the message: In this December issue of the newsletter, learn more about our ongoing expansion into North America and see photos from last month's launch of our marketing campaign in the United States, ...
childQuestions.explanationVi: Trong thông điệp của CEO, có đề cập đến việc mở rộng sang Bắc Mỹ và ra mắt chiến dịch marketing tại Mỹ. Thêm vào đó, email từ Christine Kaufmann đề cập đến việc tài liệu quảng cáo phải được gửi kịp thời cho một sự kiện ra mắt chiến dịch vào tháng 11.

childQuestions.questionText: In the form, the phrase "focused on" in paragraph 3, is closest in meaning to
options: (A) partnered with
(B) looked over
(C) dedicated to
(D) marketed for

Focus on: to give a lot of attention to one particular person, subject, or thing

dedicated to: to give completely your energy, time, etc. to something
childQuestions.explanationVi: "focused on" có nghĩa là dành nhiều sự chú ý đến một người, chủ đề hoặc điều gì đó cụ thể, và điều này gần nghĩa nhất với "dedicated to".

childQuestions.questionText: How much will Mr. Hardy probably have to pay for his class?
